_comment: Multi-server registry — source of truth for Coolify infrastructure. Template-only: hostnames, IPs, UUIDs, and domain lists are operator-set via env. Server IDs (frontend/build/backend/experimental) are AISHA reference labels — operators forking the repo edit this file or override the values via env. See servers.json.example for the AISHA reference deploy.

build.notes: Dedicated Docker build server — no runtime containers

backend.notes: Internal backend runtime — no public domains, no Traefik.

experimental.notes: Staging + AI hosting + Cosmos chain node — isolated from production

gpu.notes: GPU uzel — volitelný slot (jeden stroj = jeden slot): bydlí na něm vrstva accel (lane ACCEL_ENABLED) i firewall hostitele (accel-hostfw, A2-2; přepínač = deklarace uzlu ACCEL_FW_NODE_OWNER / ACCEL_FW_SSH, nasazuje se dřív než lane). Jeho služby se nasazují jen s otevřenou lane (config/services.json). Discovery serveru tohoto slotu NEHÁDÁ (has_gpu): vyžaduje výslovnou vazbu (GPU_HOSTNAME, SERVER_NAME/UUID prostředí nebo server_bindings profilu).
